plan.title: Replace eager AdamW with AdamW-in-backward (single fused backward+step per update)
plan.description: Swap torch.optim.AdamW for headroom.optim.in_backward_adamw.AdamWInBackward. Preserves exact parameter groups, hyperparameters (lr=1e-4, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay, foreach=False), one ordinary backward per optimizer update, data order, RNG seed, loss formulation and update cadence (20 steps). Leaf-gradient hooks update moments and release gradients inside the backward; outer step() only closes the logical update. Eliminates separate post-backward optimizer hook and its temporary workspace (foreach_sqrt, addmm, mm). Expected saving ≈ 9.13 GB (optimizer_state) + ~1.7 GB (backward temporaries) = 10.8 GB peak reduction,
plan.risk: Requires dense unscaled FP32 leaf parameters, no duplicate/shared params, exactly one backward per update, no AMP/GradScaler/clipping/DDP/compiled execution. Runtime guards reject structural violations but cannot certify absent clipping/scaling/distributed

notes: Optimizer moment tensors (8.49 GB) are the largest single persistent allocation at peak

plan.title: Remove retain_graph and accumulate loss as float

The scalar loss sum is logically equivalent to summing tensors then converting to float at the end.
